## Deferrals read

`docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` in full. In scope: **D-P30.4-1** (sig-api does not reconnect after a DB restart) and
**D-P30.4-2** (`/v1/search` unbounded, N+1, times out). Both scheduled to P31.1 at the Round-9 seed. No other OPEN
row is unblocked by this ticket (D-P30.4-3 entity race → P31.3; D-P30.1-x → P31.3/P31.4). Also read: ADR-107 (§5
restart handling, `max_connections = 100`), `runs/P30.4.md` (how the reconnect failure was observed; the
label-only-update detour onto `:latest` and the pinned-digest recycle), `reports/ROUND9_FOLLOWUPS_DESIGN.md` §5 (hosted
lessons) and §10 (ratification).

## Requirements (contract)

1. Connection resilience: a small pool or reconnect wrapper; `SET ROLE` re-applied on every new connection; liveness
   on checkout; retry an idempotent read once after a dropped connection; pool sized so (max pool) × (max instances)
   fits `max_connections = 100` alongside the jobs (arithmetic recorded); the `_connect()` compute path gets the same
   treatment.
2. A liveness/readiness endpoint, not under `/v1`, cheap, added to `probe-hosted`.
3. Bounded search: result cap (default + max, documented); cursor or offset pagination (additive fields); label +
   source lookups set-based (no N+1); a new sqitch change (deploy/revert/verify) for a `pg_trgm` GIN index (or an
   equivalent index the query uses), `pg_trgm` confirmed allowed on Cloud SQL, built `CONCURRENTLY` in a
   non-transactional change, index size measured vs the 15 GB disk first; a minimum query length; a statement
   timeout on search.
4. Tests: real-PG `pg_terminate_backend` between two requests → 200; search cap + pagination + query count; EXPLAIN
   (or recorded plan) showing the index used; route tests green for demo + PG stores.
5. Hosted roll: deploy the trgm change as the owner; Cloud Build a SHA-tagged `sig-api:api-<sha>` (never retag
   `:latest`); deploy by digest; rollback digest recorded; `probe-hosted` green; timed smoke of every `/v1` route incl.
   the heavy ones, pool usage under small concurrent load; `/v1/search?q=flock` within a few seconds, bounded;
   production reconnect proof (terminate sig-api's backends; next request 200, no redeploy).
6. Record everything; flip D-P30.4-1 / D-P30.4-2 to DONE with evidence or leave OPEN with the exact remainder.

## Acceptance criteria

- AC1 killed backend → no 500 on the next request (real-PG test + hosted proof).
- AC2 `/v1/search` capped + paginated, set-based lookups, index used (EXPLAIN), hosted `?q=flock` within a few seconds.
- AC3 pool sizing documented vs `max_connections = 100`; a health endpoint exists and is probed.
- AC4 served from a SHA-tagged digest; `:latest` unmoved; rollback digest recorded; `probe-hosted` green.
- AC5 `make check` + `make test-db` (`SIG_REQUIRE_DB_TESTS=1`) green; response changes additive only; ADR with
  `## Revisit trigger` + Appendix F row.
- Invariants: read-only API (no UPDATE/DELETE); new sqitch changes only; never fabricate green; digest-pinned
  deploys; `$SIG_GCP_PROJECT` in committed text, never the literal id; secrets env-only; no merge/tag/push-main.
- Out of scope (confirmed not done): caching layers, CDN, rate limiting; static-site changes; write path / spine writes.

## Plan

1. `PgReadStore`: replace the single connection with a `psycopg_pool` pool; a `_pooled` decorator binds one
   connection per public read (thread-local, re-entrant); one retry policy (`_retrying`) for pooled reads and the
   dedicated compute connection; `StoreUnavailable` → 503; `application_name = sig-api`.
2. `GET /health` (app level, not `/v1`) over `ReadStore.health()`; a `probe-hosted` target in `ops/cadence.toml`.
3. `/v1/search`: route-level input bounds (min searchable term, `limit` 1…200, `cursor`), additive `limit` +
   `next_cursor`; store-level keyset query + set-based labels/sources + transaction-local statement timeout;
   `InMemoryStore` gets the same keyset semantics.
4. sqitch `entity_identifier_value_trgm` (non-transactional, CONCURRENTLY); measure hosted size first.
5. Tests (demo + real PG), `make check` / `make test-db` / e2e.
6. Hosted: schema deploy → Cloud Build `sig-api:api-<sha>` → 0 % candidate by digest → smoke → promote → load +
   search timings → the ONE approved terminate drill → `probe-hosted` → spine read-back.
7. ADR-108 + Appendix F + BL-057 mapping; DEFERRALS; GCP_DEPLOYMENT; close (LEDGER, BUILD_INDEX row 142).

Base health (before any change): `make check` → 3,924 passed, 3 skipped, EXIT 0 (Docker up, DB tests ran).

  dependency.

  at 19:19:07Z.
- **The ONE approved hosted terminate drill** (19:19:42Z): all 5 `application_name = sig-api` backends terminated
  (5 other sessions untouched). No 500, no redeploy — but the first request was a **503 after 10,175 ms**; every
  later request 200 on 5 fresh backends. Cause: `psycopg_pool`'s checkout `check=` walks the dead idle connections
  with a 1 s / 2 s / 4 s backoff. **Fix** (commit `10025fb`): no checkout check; a read whose connection died calls
  `ConnectionPool.check()` and retries once. A new real-PG test kills all 5 pooled backends and requires the next
  request to be 200 in < 2 s — it fails under the old config (503) and passes under the fix.
- Image 2 `sig-api:api-10025fbe1fd8` → `sha256:21bb9526…`; 0 % candidate `sig-api-00008-qir` (tag `p31d`) smoked;
  promoted at 19:27:01Z; tags removed. **No second terminate** (only one was approved): the fixed image's hosted
  fast-path proof is the D-P30.4-1 remainder (PARTIAL).
- Post-roll: search paging/timings + concurrent load on the live URL; `probe-hosted` 8/8; spine read-back.

## Evidence report

The PR body `docs/build/pr/P31.1.md` is the evidence report (written once, reused). In short:

- **AC1 (reconnect): met in code + real PG; hosted proof PARTIAL.** Real-PG: kill between two requests → 200 with
  `SET ROLE` re-applied; all five pooled backends killed → next request 200 in < 2 s; compute path recovers. Hosted
  (the one approved drill, first image): no 500 and no redeploy, but the first request was a 503 after 10.2 s; the
  cause was found, fixed, regression-tested and rolled (`sha256:21bb9526…`). The served image's hosted proof waits for
  the next restart or a second approved drill (D-P30.4-1 PARTIAL).
- **AC2 (search): met.** Capped (50/200), keyset `next_cursor`, set-based (4 statements/page), 5 s per statement,
  3-alnum minimum; trigram index used for selective terms, `entity_pkey` early-stop walk for broad ones (hosted
  EXPLAIN ANALYZE); live `q=flock` median 390 ms. D-P30.4-2 DONE.
- **AC3 (pool + health): met.** 2 × (5 + 1) = 12 of 100 (roll overlap 24); `/health` + `probe-hosted` target; live
  pool ≤ 5, waiting ≤ 2 under 8-way load.
- **AC4 (roll): met.** Serving `sha256:21bb9526…` (`sig-api-00008-qir`, tag `api-10025fbe1fd8`); `:latest` unmoved
  (`sha256:ebb6dab9…`); rollback `sha256:cc680111…` (`sig-api-00004-jdj`); `probe-hosted` 8/8.
- **AC5 (gates): met.** `make check` 3,953 passed, `make test-db` 209, e2e 16, validators green; response changes
  additive (`limit`, `next_cursor`; `/health` new); ADR-108 with Revisit trigger + Appendix F row.
- **Opened:** D-P31.1-1 (annotation watermark ~10 s, pre-existing), D-P31.1-2 (scheduled probe image lacks the
  target, P31.4), D-P31.1-3 (`/v1/entity` 404 on an unregistered predicate, pre-existing).
